# New ISO certification bolsters C.H. Robinson’s status as leading automotive logistics provider


#### Certification brings cutting-edge offerings to sophisticated automotive supply chains


-
-
-
-

Copy to clipboard


Link Copied


November 6, 2026 | Press Release


**EDEN PRAIRIE, Minn., (Nov. 6, 2026)** — C.H. Robinson, the global leader in Lean AI supply chains, has achieved ISO 9001:2015 certification for automotive supply chains. The internationally recognized certification validates the company’s quality management processes and gives customers confidence in the consistency, reliability and continuous improvement of its[automotive logistics](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/shippers/industries/automotive-logistics/) operations.


In addition to global-forwarding services being certified, now the company’s North American Surface Transportation brokerage services are as well, including trucking, cross-border, cross-dock, consolidation, domestic air and intermodal.


“The ISO 9001:2015 certification affirms that C.H. Robinson delivers consistent, high-quality service for the automotive industry,” said James Mancini, VP for Customer Success. “Automotive supply chains demand precision and reliability. This certification reflects the expertise and tailored solutions we bring to customers every day. Combined with our global scale and Lean AI technology, we help shippers navigate complexity and keep their automotive parts and components moving.”


The automotive ISO certification is focused on quality management and process consistency. This includes:


- Reinforcing the precise execution of time-critical automotive shipments through documented processes, increased visibility and standard procedures executed by those trained in the standards.
- Equipping teams to proactively identify risks, resolve issues, and meet customer and regulatory requirements.
- Helping customers mitigate supply-chain disruptions and maintain production continuity.


**About C.H. Robinson Automotive Logistics**


Managing more than 1 million automotive shipments each year, C.H. Robinson’s services and tech are tailored to the needs of automotive supply chains. C.H. Robinson serves the majority of the top 10 automakers and the top 100 Tier 1 suppliers, as well as the aftermarket parts industry. The company’s global team of experts includes automotive centers of excellence in North America, Latin America, Europe, India, China and Australia.


In Mexico and along the Mexico-U.S. border, C.H. Robinson has 35 years of experience, bilingual teams, and 2 million sq. ft. of cross-dock and warehouse facilities in key cities and crossing points critical to automotive manufacturing centers. The company’s[cross-border consolidation service](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/resources/blog/automotive-cross-border-freight-consolidation) can save cross-border shippers up to 40% and gives them visibility to their freight up to 48 hours earlier. It uniquely combines freight consolidation in Mexico, cross-border transport, customs brokerage and bonded warehousing with the largest network of carriers and AI-optimized delivery across the United States and Canada.


#### About C.H. Robinson


C.H. Robinson is the global leader in Lean AI supply chains. For more than a century, companies everywhere have looked to us to reimagine how goods move. Now, as we redefine what’s next for the industry, that same drive fuels our commitment to Building Tomorrow’s Supply Chains, Today™. Trusted by 74,000 customers and 450,000 contract carriers, we manage an unmatched 37 million shipments annually, representing $23 billion in freight. We deliver tailored solutions across the world via truckload, less-than-truckload, ocean, air, and more. With our unique combination of human insight and Lean AI working as one, supply chains move faster, smarter, and more sustainably. As a responsible global citizen, we proudly contribute millions to the causes that matter most to our employees. For more information visit[www.chrobinson.com](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/) . (Nasdaq: CHRW)
